It stays near zero on ordinary story nouns, verbs, names and function words, and on whole-token words such as snail, snake, zoo, zombie, scared, school, gold, ring, stone, mirror, diamond, coin, snow, apple, dog, cat, girl, park, house, flower, doll, lunch and dinner.
